offering_description.value: TWFG places personal and commercial property and casualty insurance for individuals and businesses. It distributes policies from multiple insurers through retail agencies and provides specialty underwriting and placement through its managing general agency.

primary_products.value: homeowners insurance; personal auto insurance; commercial property insurance; commercial liability insurance; specialty property and casualty insurance

primary_services.value: retail insurance brokerage; wholesale insurance placement; delegated underwriting; policy administration; independent agency support

customer_segment.value: B2C: Homeowners, motorists and other individual policyholders; B2B: Businesses buying coverage, independent insurance agencies and insurance carriers

end_markets.value: personal property and casualty insurance; commercial property and casualty insurance; specialty insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Carrier-paid commissions on policies placed or renewed, including performance-based commissions; service fees: Fees for policy administration and agency support
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Places coverage from insurance carriers with households and businesses; service provider: Uses delegated carrier authority to underwrite and place specialty coverage through independent agents

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with a concentration in Texas, California and Louisiana

specialization.value: related lines: Personal insurance brokerage, commercial insurance brokerage and specialty managing general agency services

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Affiliated retail agents and independent agencies that place coverage through its wholesale operation; own locations: Company-operated retail insurance branches

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments license producers and agencies and regulate delegated underwriting and surplus lines placement.

notes: The current mix of company-operated and affiliated branches is uncertain.
